entries.title: Ephesians 3:1
segments: ¶For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:2
segments: If that ordering of the grace of God has come to your knowledge, which was given to me for you,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:3
segments: How by revelation the secret was made clear to me, as I said before in a short letter,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:4
segments: By the reading of which you will be clear about my knowledge of the secret of Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:5
segments: Which in other generations was not given to the sons of men, but the revelation of it has now been made to his holy Apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:6
segments: Which is that the Gentiles have a part in the heritage, and in the same body, and in the same hope in Christ through the good news,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:7
segments: Of which I was made a preacher, through that grace of God which was given to me in the measure of the working of his power.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:8
segments: To me, who am less than the least of all the saints, was this grace given, so that I might make clear to the Gentiles the good news of the unending wealth of Christ:

entries.title: Ephesians 3:9
segments: And make all men see what is the ordering of the secret which from the first has been kept in God who made all things;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:10
segments: So that now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavens might be made clear through the church the wide-shining wisdom of God,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:11
segments: Which is seen in his eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord:

entries.title: Ephesians 3:12
segments: By whom we come near to God without fear through faith in him.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:13
segments: For this reason it is my prayer that you may not become feeble because of my troubles for you, which are your glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:14
segments: ¶For this cause I go down on my knees before the Father,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:15
segments: From whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:16
segments: That in the wealth of his glory he would make you strong with power through his Spirit in your hearts;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:17
segments: So that Christ may have his place in your hearts through faith; and that you, being rooted and based in love,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:18
segments: May have strength to see with all the saints how wide and long and high and deep it is,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:19
segments: And to have knowledge of the love of Christ which is outside all knowledge, so that you may be made complete as God himself is complete.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20
segments: Now to him who is able to do in full measure more than all our desires or thoughts, through the power which is working in us,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:21
segments: To him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations for ever and ever. So be it.
